summary.intent: Execute Phase 19.2 (IPFS upload performance optimization) using wave-based parallel execution across 2 plans: concurrent pin orchestration in the SDK and pebbleds datastore configuration.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 completed fully — concurrent pin orchestration implemented in the SDK using Promise.allSettled. Wave 2 partially completed — Docker Compose updated with pebbleds datastore profile and pushed to remote; checkpoint was hit requiring manual infrastructure redeployment on 192.168.133.114.

repo: Phase 19.2 targets IPFS upload performance on cipher-box, with infrastructure running on Docker host at 192.168.133.114
The primary upload latency bottleneck was sequential IPNS publish and folder metadata update steps — now parallelized with Promise.allSettled
Docker Compose for IPFS uses a named volume `cipherbox-infrastructure_ipfs_data` that must be deleted when switching datastores (pebbleds needs a fresh repo)
Kubo IPFS node is accessed as container named `cipherbox-ipfs`
Branch naming convention for this phase: `feat/phase-19.2-ipfs-upload-perf` (user-created) vs GSD computed `phase-19.2-ipfs-upload-performance-optimization`

code.finding: uploadFile now uses Promise.allSettled to parallelize IPNS publish and folder metadata update; 4 tests added covering concurrency and partial failure handling
Updated with pebbleds datastore profile for Kubo — improves write throughput

workflow: GSD checkpoint plans (autonomous: false) pause execution and surface structured action prompts to the user before continuing
When infrastructure changes require remote deployment, pushing the branch first lets the user pull directly rather than manual file copying
Continuation agents are spawned fresh (not resumed) after checkpoints — they verify prior commits and continue from the resume task
Pre-wave dependency checks via `gsd-tools verify key-links` run before each wave 2+ to catch wiring gaps early

friction: Branch name mismatch: GSD computed `phase-19.2-ipfs-upload-performance-optimization` but user had already created `feat/phase-19.2-ipfs-upload-perf` — orchestrator had to detect and adapt
Pebbleds datastore migration requires volume deletion, meaning previously pinned content needs re-pinning — destructive infrastructure change
Checkpoint for infrastructure redeployment required manual user intervention and a separate git push step before the stack could be updated
